title: Spiritbinder Trenzar and Senvial of the Mist
summary: Break Spiritbinder Trenzar’s hold over Senvial of the Mist.
overview: Break Spiritbinder Trenzar’s hold over Senvial of the Mist.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Trenzar creates a bound elemental every ten seconds and brings the elementals onto the group’s hate list. Keep add control active throughout the fight.
Wave of Flame begins fourteen seconds after engagement and repeats every twenty seconds.
Senvial appears after a random delay of seventy-five to one hundred twenty seconds. Bring Senvial to 10% health and defeat Trenzar to release the spirit.
Once Senvial stops fighting, the eligible ranger should hail the freed spirit to advance the epic quest.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
